ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut, both halves gate spot-checked. LimitLoadToSessionType is inert: excluded from serialization (json:"-", 'never rendered into the plist, never stored', launchd/agent.go:142-152) and cleared by acceptIgnoredSessionType during canonicalization (policy.go) with a warning on non-Aqua values — the original wedge trigger is gone. Classification/recovery: loadOnce runs bootout -> enable -> bootstrap -> kickstart per pass (launchd/apply.go:265-279), settle retries only launchctlInFlux (exits 36/37, apply.go:239-263), and exit 5 is the never-decoded aggregate status that surfaces immediately as a hard unclassified failure with `launchctl error` / log-show diagnostic guidance (launchctl.go:18-23, 62-83, 119-128) instead of burning retries.
